runtime.quote:
Before installing, ensure you have:
- **Python 3.12+** installed
- **Docker** installed and running ([Get Docker](https://docs.docker.com/get-docker/))
- An **API key** for your chosen agent (e.g., Anthropic, OpenAI, Google)
